taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Odufor (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Odufor
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: 1.24 m – 17.04 m
Recommendation: Target the thick, high-resistivity sand unit (Layer 3, ~2512 Ω·m) between approximately 1.2 m and 17.0 m depth as the primary water-bearing zone; case off the thin conductive topsoil (0–0.14 m) and screen the borehole within this resistive sand interval to optimize yield.
